Name: Amariah, Son of Azariah
Summary: Son of Azariah and priest in Aaron's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:11; 1 Chronicles 6:52: Son of Azariah and priest in Aaron's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Amariah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
